_source: CORE ELA Pacing Guide 4th Grade - Open Up EL Education, uploaded 8/30/26, transcribed by week (parsed from the guide's M | U | L labels and lesson titles, cross-checked against Appendix A's Grade 4 ELA bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md).
_note: Module = EL Education Module, Unit = the Unit within that Module (stored as a string; lesson numbers reset per Unit, as in Grades K/1/2/3). Unlike those grades, no week in this guide crosses a Module or Unit boundary - every one of the 36 weeks is a single segment. 'assessment' names any Unit Assessment / Performance Task falling within that segment's lessons - 'Mid-Unit'/'End of Unit'/'Part I/II' and colon detail are dropped, keeping only the base tag ('Unit N Assessment' or 'Performance Task'); a tag repeated across lessons in the same segment (e.g. weeks 2, 3, 6, 9, etc.) is written once. This guide runs the full 36 weeks with no early finish, matching Grade 3's ELA file (unlike this grade's own OUR Math file, which ends at week 35). One header/body typo, same family as prior grades: week 13's table header reads 'Module 2 | Unit 1' but every lesson that week is tagged M2|U2 and the title matches Unit 2's own name ('Using Writing to Inform') printed at week 14 - transcribed as Module 2 Unit 2, confirmed against Appendix A, which lists the same M2 U2 lessons for that week. Two title duplications in the guide itself, confirmed harmless and reproduced identically in Appendix A (so not a transcription artifact): week 32's M4|U2|L9 and L10 share the exact title 'Writing a Literary Essay: Analyzing a Model'; week 36's M4|U3|L15 reuses week 34's M4|U3|L1 title verbatim ('Launching Research of How Kids Can Take Action'). Neither affects lesson numbering - both are real, distinct, contiguous lesson numbers. Lesson accounting is contiguous from 1 within each of the twelve Module/Unit pairs (M1: 12, 14, 11 lessons; M2: 11, 12, 15; M3: 11, 13, 15; M4: 10, 13, 15), with no gaps or duplicates.
